title: On Yielding a fine crop despite the drought
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：yield　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 yield 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the counsellor ① yielded a fine crop despite the drought in public, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the counsellor ② yields a fine crop despite the drought in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ yield a fine crop despite the drought at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ yielded a fine crop despite the drought before — a line in the journal for June 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Yielding a fine crop despite the drought in public, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ yield to nobody on this point in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Yield to nobody on this point at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new listener from the next garden ⑧ yields to nobody on this point in public every evening without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ yielded a fine crop despite the drought again when nobody else would.

⑩ To yield a fine crop despite the drought, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody yields a fine crop despite the drought in silence again and somebody must yield a fine crop despite the drought in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 产出（一般过去式 yielded a fine crop despite the drought：1991 年谈心人头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 产出（一般现在 yields a fine crop despite the drought：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 产出（不定式 to yield a fine crop despite the drought：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 产出（过去完成时 had yielded a fine crop despite the drought：1985 年六月的心记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 产出（动名词 yielding a fine crop despite the drought 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 让步（yield to nobody on this point：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去让步在这一点上不让任何人）
G. v. 让步（yield to nobody on this point：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 产出（后段两处：新来的倾听者照例 yields to nobody on this point，而母亲又一次 yielded a fine crop despite the drought）

answers.why: yield 意为“产出”，1991 年谈心人当着众人面产出尽管天旱仍有一季好收成，那是小园里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 yielded。
yield 意为“产出”，自那以后谈心人一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 yields。
yield 意为“产出”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯产出尽管天旱仍有一季好收成”，此处为不定式 to yield a fine crop despite the drought。
yield 意为“产出”，心记里 六月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人产出过，故用过去完成时 had yielded。
yield 意为“产出”，谈心人说“产出尽管天旱仍有一季好收成这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 yielding a fine crop despite the drought 作主语。
yield 意为“让步”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去让步在这一点上不让任何人”，should ever 之后用原形 yield to nobody on this point。
yield 意为“让步”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻让步在这一点上不让任何人（yield to nobody on this point at once），以后再也不要提起。
yield 意为“产出”，新来的倾听者每个黄昏都照例让步在这一点上不让任何人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 yields。
yield 意为“产出”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面产出尽管天旱仍有一季好收成，用一般过去式 yielded 叙述。
yield 意为“产出”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要产出尽管天旱仍有一季好收成，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和小园记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 yield 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the counsellor yielded a fine crop despite the drought in public, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the counsellor yields a fine crop despite the drought in silence whenever the garden asks.
Yielding a fine crop despite the drought in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever yield to nobody on this point in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next garden yields to nobody on this point in public every evening, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother yielded a fine crop despite the drought again, and the garden remembered that half.
